prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory severity filter in package solution.

Export Severity, constants Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Fatal in increasing severity order, LogEntry with Level Severity and Message string, ErrInvalidLevel, ParseSeverity(string) (Severity, error), and FilterLogs(minimum string, entries []LogEntry) ([]LogEntry, error).

Parsing trims whitespace and is ASCII case-insensitive for debug, info, warn, error, and fatal; all other values, including empty input, are invalid. FilterLogs first validates the minimum and every entry severity. Invalid input returns nil and ErrInvalidLevel without a partial result. Return entries whose severity is at least the minimum, preserving order and duplicates. Empty messages are valid. Return a non-nil empty slice if nothing matches. The result must use fresh storage and the input must not be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
